company_name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

breakdown.rationale: Filing describes specific physical accessibility measures -- structural mobility accommodations and visual signage for hearing-impaired personnel at a majority of sites, plus an ongoing phased infrastructure upgrade for remaining facilities -- but no digital accessibility (website/app/assistive technology) is mentioned at all.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose digital accessibility measures (e.g., website/app conformance, assistive technology support) alongside the physical infrastructure upgrades.

breakdown.rationale: A Human Rights Policy with explicit clauses on equal opportunity and workplace facilities for persons with disabilities is named and linked, but no concrete accommodation-request process is described.
breakdown.recommendation: Describe a specific process by which a PwD employee can request and receive a workplace accommodation, including response-time expectations.

breakdown.rationale: Specific PwD headcounts are disclosed (1 differently abled employee, 3 differently abled workers) against a total workforce of over 6,600, which is verifiable but very limited and given without trend or contextual detail.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD headcount trends year-over-year and by function/location.

breakdown.rationale: No disability-specific recruitment target, outreach programme, or hiring attainment figure is disclosed anywhere in the filing.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose a PwD hiring target and any disability-focused recruitment outreach, with attainment reported.

breakdown.rationale: No PwD-specific attrition, tenure, or promotion data is disclosed; the general turnover and retention tables are not broken out by disability status.
breakdown.recommendation: Track and disclose attrition/retention rates specifically for PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: No data on PwD representation in senior or management roles is disclosed; leadership diversity disclosures cover only gender (e.g., women in top/middle/junior management).
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose PwD representation figures specifically at senior/management levels.

breakdown.rationale: No disability-specific training or sensitization programme is described; the learning and development section covers e-learning, POSH, leadership and technical training but does not mention disability awareness.
breakdown.recommendation: Introduce and disclose a disability-awareness/sensitization training module.

breakdown.rationale: No ongoing PwD-specific culture practices (ERG, flexible work, accommodation response-time commitment) are disclosed beyond the general non-discrimination policy statement.
breakdown.recommendation: Establish and disclose concrete ongoing PwD-inclusion practices such as an employee resource group or accommodation turnaround commitment.

breakdown.rationale: No PwD-specific satisfaction or grievance data is disclosed; the annual Employee Engagement Survey ('Connections') reports overall and gender-related scores but no disability breakdown.
breakdown.recommendation: Track and disclose employee engagement/grievance metrics specifically for PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: Filing directly answers the mandated BRSR RPwD Act questions, stating major sites/plants are accessible to differently abled employees, workers and visitors, but frames coverage as 'a majority' of facilities with phased upgrades still underway at the rest; no statutory employment quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is stated.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose the specific RPwD Act statutory employment quota attainment percentage and target date for completing accessibility upgrades at all remaining facilities.
